name: Ibrahim Traoré
role: Interim president of Burkina Faso and head of the military junta (2022–present)
summary: Military officer who took power in a coup in September 2022 and styles his rule a popular progressive revolution in the tradition of Thomas Sankara. He is anti-imperialist and pan-Africanist, openly rejects democracy and party politics as unsuited to his country, and pursues state control of gold mining, self-reliance and alignment with Russia and the Sahel confederation.

notes:
Leads a military junta: only his own words and measures he drove are used; statements by ministers and joint AES communiqués are low confidence or null. In April 2025 he said democracy is only the end point of a revolution; by April 2026 he said democracy is not for Burkina Faso. Several answers rest on his government record rather than direct statements.

Merged with an independent gpt-6.1-sol audit: 38 answers taken from it, 20 agreed, 0 conflicts settled by the integrator.

gpt-6.1-sol notes: Independent audit; no previous answers consulted and no living-person inference. Three of ten priorities answered: state/church separation, scriptural law and religious nationhood. Complete active list and all nulls reviewed. Personal faith, blessings and prayer invitations do not establish divine political legitimacy, spiritual warfare, blasphemy penalties or a demand for more religion throughout public life. No direct abortion position or state-school religious-instruction policy found. July religious statements are reported, not a complete transcript; commentary defending them is excluded. Formal assent to the anti-LGBT family code does not alone establish personal authorship of its provisions, so no private-sex or marriage conclusion is drawn from ministers’ statements. The full manifesto text is listed in notFound; publication notices and chapter headings are not a substitute. Women’s productive emancipation does not establish legal gender-role distinctions, universal socialized childcare or equal-outcome doctrine. Cooperatives in particular sectors do not establish wholesale communal society or abolition of private ownership. Ordinary economic investment is not a comprehensive central-planning blueprint. Reforestation’s human benefits do not establish intrinsic nature value, natural-capital accounting or environmental priority over liberty and growth. Nuclear generation does not establish nuclear-weapons policy. Generating electricity from imported fuel does not establish domestic fossil extraction. Recognition of traditional justice is not proof of customary chiefs’ national legislative advisory powers. Revolutionary language does not establish proletarian dictatorship, Marxist historical causation or a small armed-group theory. Financial sovereignty through gold does not establish abolition of central banking. National food preference is not a hermetically sealed imperial trading bloc. His economic and security success claims are not independently verified; their stated policy purposes are used. Massacres by security personnel are serious documented context, but command responsibility or his direct orders are not presumed from office alone. No unconditional security-accountability answer is drawn from his contested denials. Field equipment training and temporary foreign instructors do not settle a categorical foreign-base ban.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Pledged in an RTB interview to build a strong army.

bypass-parties-groups.rationale: Dissolved all political parties, calling them divisive.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Describes neocolonialism and imperialism as slavery that Africa must reject.

collective-defense.rationale: Burkina Faso under him is party to the AES charter whose Articles 6-7 make an attack on one member an aggression against all, with a duty of assistance including armed force.

collective-farming.rationale: He supports women’s cooperative farming with state-provided productive space.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Denounces colonial and neocolonial extraction of Africa's wealth.

conscription.rationale: Signed the April 2023 general mobilisation decree under which able-bodied people aged 18 and over can be called to enrol and persons and goods requisitioned.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Rule continued without election: the May 2024 charter set a 60-month transition from July 2024, with Traoré allowed to stand afterwards, adopted by a consultation most parties boycotted.

death-penalty.rationale: He explicitly supports executing spies and traitors.

democracy-best.rationale: Extended unelected military rule five years from July 2024 and dissolved all political parties in January 2026.

direct-action.rationale: Says change comes by revolution, with democracy only the end result, rather than through elections and parliaments.

dominated-front.rationale: Calls on African leaders to stop acting as imperialism's puppets and frames Burkina Faso's struggle as anti-neocolonial.

duties-before-rights.rationale: He explicitly says revolution brings more duties than rights.

elective-rulers.rationale: The transition charter he oversaw extended unelected military rule by five years from July 2024 instead of holding the promised elections.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: He rejects ordinary expression freedoms during revolutionary wartime mobilization.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Mixed: ended defence cooperation with France and other Western powers, but joined a mutual-defence alliance with Mali and Niger (the AES charter).

equal-moral-worth.rationale: He rejects treating Africans as subhuman.

every-country-ready-for-democracy.rationale: Said democracy is "not for us" and that Burkina Faso should forget it, which contradicts every country being ready for it.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Asked Putin for a small nuclear power plant to generate electricity for Burkina Faso and the subregion.

free-trade.rationale: He calls import dependence a trap and wants imports exceptional.

future-generations.rationale: He urges protecting trees and passing ecological stewardship to future generations.

gradual-change.rationale: Said "the revolution is a rupture" and that he would not follow a set direction; wants revolution in mentality and industry rather than step-by-step change.

head-commands-forces.rationale: Acts as head of the military junta and by decree dismissed the prime minister and dissolved the government in December 2024.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: He defines liberation through food, economic and monetary sovereignty.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: He makes industrialization a development imperative.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Said "we have our own model" and that democracy as shown by the West is not for Africans; each people should find its own system.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: His government joined the September 2025 announcement that Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger are leaving the ICC as a "neocolonial" instrument.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: He rejects religious law taking precedence over the common constitution.

leader-cult.rationale: He promotes a national hero’s memorial as a living source of civic instruction.

local-production.rationale: Ordered army rations from locally processed products instead of imports.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Pursued nationalisation and state exploitation of gold and rejected past partnership models with multinationals; no explicit statement on markets.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: He demands eternal glory and continuing remembrance for national martyrs.

military-guardian-role.rationale: Military rule was extended five years from July 2024 under a charter drawn up with the security forces, replacing the promised return to civilian electoral rule.

multipolar-world.rationale: Told Putin: "We want a multipolar world, and we stand for sovereignty."

nation-first.rationale: He puts national productive sovereignty ahead of imported convenience.

national-rebirth.rationale: He calls for a transformed national citizenry escaping imposed dependency.

national-resource-control.rationale: Took foreign-run gold mines into state hands and pursues nationalist gold-mining and domestic refining.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Called armed volunteers who take up arms against terrorists patriots and defended their right to defend themselves; leads the armed campaign.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Expanded the state into gold mining through state-owned mining acquisitions.

party-controls-media.rationale: HRW documents arrests and forced conscription of critical journalists and a clampdown on media under his government.

patriotic-education.rationale: He wants youth taught service and the national revolutionary legacy.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Said a "real politician" in Burkina embodies every vice: liar, sycophant, smooth-talker.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: In his April 2026 interview he backs the AES confederation he chairs as a pooling of resources and sovereignty; he left ECOWAS, so the stance is on specific unions.

positive-liberty.rationale: He defines women’s autonomy through practical productive opportunities and resources.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: He defends indigenous food, dress and intergenerational cultural knowledge.

religious-nation.rationale: He makes secular coexistence foundational to the common national destiny.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Argued (Apr 2025, Apr 2026) that development needs revolution, order and discipline first and that "libertinage" of action or expression has no place; democracy is only the outcome.

revolution-legitimate.rationale: Calls his rule a revolution and says change comes by rupture, with democracy only the end point of a revolution.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Criticised African leaders who "beg" and urged food and economic self-sufficiency.

separate-church-state.rationale: Secular nationhood coexists with mandatory sermon supervision.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Promotes state-backed processing plants, cooperatives and state-led infrastructure and engineering for development.

state-harmful.rationale: Took gold mining into state hands and expanded the state economic role.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: He would impose authorized religious sermons.

suppress-opposition.rationale: His government dissolved all political parties in January 2026 and, per HRW, cracked down on media and opposition, including arrests and forced conscription of critics.

tech-with-ancestral-values.rationale: He combines ancestral processing knowledge with modern machinery and girls’ technical training.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Uniformed cohorts train under military commands in the compulsory patriotic immersion.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: His emancipation programme centers economic autonomy and collective productive capacity.

worker-ownership.rationale: He promotes producer-owned cooperatives and joint processing enterprises.
